name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster

eax.problem: The 25th Anniversary Remaster runs on Nightdive's proprietary Kex Engine, a from-scratch rewrite — it never had DirectSound3D EAX to begin with.

notes: If you own the classic 1999 build, run this script against that installation instead — it has real DirectSound3D EAX support (plus NewDark's own OpenAL Soft 'Hardware Acceleration' option), neither of which this remaster's rewritten engine provides.
